verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents international Transfers/Batch Transfers to global beneficiaries in multiple currencies, Global Accounts for local receiving, and a Transactional FX API offering market or guaranteed rates — directly addressing local-currency payments with rate transparency. Fee transparency is implied via guaranteed rates and no-FX-fee card claims but not itemized with a full fee schedule. Missing for 10: independent/third-party verification of actual fee transparency and no first-hand corroboration of pricing clarity.
